unit: Marked [REC] evals only; non-overlapping wall-clock windows; session-level selection/validation. Correlated windows ≠ independent trials.

limitations: REAL_20261019T153012Z: sparse sampling (~0.61 Hz); 3s windows may contain only 1–2 scored frames.
No face-track / identity continuity IDs in JSONL — windows group by wall clock only.
Sampling rate differs across sessions (~0.6 Hz early REAL vs ~5 Hz later REAL vs ~20 Hz attack).
Non-overlapping windows within one session are correlated; do not treat as independent trials.
NO_FACE / MULTIPLE_FACES frames occupy wall-clock time but contribute no REAL-class scores.
Approach A REAL still requires native argmax REAL + winning-score gate; mean/median methods use REAL-class mass and can diverge from Approach A on the same frames.
Only 1 data-bearing SCREEN session(s); need >=2 for independent selection+validation split.
split_info.unit: data-bearing sessions (zero-eval files excluded from split)
